# Test mod for triggering parser syntax errors
# Load this mod and watch error.log for parser messages
# Use with x64dbg breakpoints on error strings

namespace = re_broken_syntax

# ERROR 1: Missing equals sign
re_broken_syntax.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title  re_broken_syntax.0001.t    # <-- INTENTIONAL: Missing =
	desc = re_broken_syntax.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		is_alive = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = re_broken_syntax.0001.a
	}
}

# ERROR 2: Unclosed brace
re_broken_syntax.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = re_broken_syntax.0002.t
	desc = re_broken_syntax.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_alive = yes
	# <-- INTENTIONAL: Missing closing brace

	option = {
		name = re_broken_syntax.0002.a
	}
}

# ERROR 3: Extra closing brace
re_broken_syntax.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = re_broken_syntax.0003.t
	desc = re_broken_syntax.0003.desc

	trigger = {
		is_alive = yes
	}}  # <-- INTENTIONAL: Extra brace

	option = {
		name = re_broken_syntax.0003.a
	}
}

# ERROR 4: Invalid assignment target
re_broken_syntax.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	123 = invalid_number_key    # <-- INTENTIONAL: Number as key
	title = re_broken_syntax.0004.t

	option = {
		name = re_broken_syntax.0004.a
	}
}

# ERROR 5: Malformed string
re_broken_syntax.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = "unclosed string    # <-- INTENTIONAL: Unclosed quote

	option = {
		name = re_broken_syntax.0005.a
	}
}
